selection_rule: Exactly these three candidates are in V0. A fourth idea, an omitted variant, or a replacement requires V1 and a new preregistration.

candidates.display_name: Quarter-hour boundary order imbalance -> subsequent medium-horizon return
candidates.citation: Chan Kim and Peter Reinhard Hansen (2026), The Quarter-Hour Effect: Periodic Algorithmic Trading and Return Predictability in Cryptocurrency Futures, arXiv:2607.09426.
candidates.external_sample: Six Binance perpetual contracts; paper reports out-of-sample order-imbalance predictability for 4-to-12-hour returns.
candidates.external_universe: Six Binance perpetual contracts (exact paper universe is not imported as QntyLab universe).
candidates.overlap_risk: Same venue and instrument family as the seed paper; this is a temporal/mechanism test, not an independent discovery or provider replication.
candidates.exact_proposition: At each UTC quarter-hour boundary t, the signed taker quote-volume imbalance accumulated during [t,t+15m) is positively associated with the subsequent 8-hour BTCUSDT perpetual log return measured from the 15-minute close at t+15m through t+8h+15m.
candidates.timestamp_convention: UTC quarter-hour t is the opening boundary; trades with event timestamp >= t and < t+15m are included; the outcome starts at the 15-minute bar close at t+15m.
candidates.safe_known_after: SAFE-KNOWN-AFTER >= t+15m boundary, after all aggregate trades in the interval are closed and materialized.
candidates.outcome: Y_t = log(C_15m,t+8h+15m / C_15m,t+15m), using first-party USD-M 15-minute kline closes.
candidates.inclusion_exclusion: BTCUSDT USD-M perpetual only; no symbol substitution, cross-asset pooling, survivor selection, or contract-type substitution.
candidates.missing_data: Any missing trade interval, kline, nonfinite value, duplicate identity, timestamp-unit ambiguity, or continuity failure blocks the candidate and the common campaign; no row dropping.
candidates.duplicate_behavior: Duplicate archive rows are an integrity failure unless they are byte-identical duplicate records with the same exchange trade identity; deduplication is not a rescue.
candidates.benchmark: Intercept-only mean-return benchmark, reported descriptively; no trading benchmark.
candidates.primary_metric_statistic: OLS slope beta on QH_OBI with intercept; two-sided HAC p-value and 95% confidence interval, direction gated.
candidates.inference_procedure: Newey-West Bartlett HAC with fixed lag 32 fifteen-minute observations (8 hours); no lag selection.
candidates.dependence_handling: HAC accounts for serial dependence; quarter-hour observations overlap in outcomes and are not treated as iid.
candidates.multiplicity_treatment: Holm step-down across exactly JFP01, JFP02, JFP03 raw two-sided p-values at familywise alpha 0.05.
candidates.materiality_rule: Supported only if beta has the preregistered sign, Holm p <= 0.05, and the absolute predicted 8-hour return difference between the 90th and 10th feature percentiles is >= 5 bps; percentile contrast is descriptive and computed from the frozen sample without threshold tuning.
candidates.historical_source_contract: Binance first-party USD-M public archive: data.binance.vision/data/futures/um/monthly/aggTrades/BTCUSDT/BTCUSDT-aggTrades-YYYY-MM.zip plus .../klines/BTCUSDT/15m/BTCUSDT-15m-YYYY-MM.zip; expected trade timestamp milliseconds unless archive metadata explicitly binds another unit; archive .CHECKSUM and post-materialization SHA-256 are mandatory.
candidates.prospective_observation_semantics: Persist QH_OBI and its event receipt at each quarter-hour after SAFE-KNOWN-AFTER, before the return outcome matures; no order, position, or capital action.
candidates.prospective_maturity_condition: Outcome is mature only at t+8h+15m and is evaluated once against the immutable event identity.
integrity_kill_conditions: source replacement without a new authenticated receipt
candidates.no_rescue_rule: No alternate mark, horizon, interval, sign, threshold, feature transform, asset, subgroup, or implementation may replace this candidate after freeze.
candidates.candidate_origin_provenance: Prior seed only; no local QntyLab outcome was used to choose this specification.

candidates.display_name: Perpetual premium dislocation -> subsequent premium compression
candidates.citation: Ackerer, Hugonnier and Jermann (2024), Perpetual Futures Pricing, NBER Working Paper 32936 / Mathematical Finance; perpetual-futures pricing and funding anchor mechanism.
candidates.external_sample: Theoretical pricing analysis; not an empirical QntyLab result and not a copied local specification.
candidates.external_universe: Linear perpetual futures in the pricing framework; no external empirical universe imported.
candidates.overlap_risk: Mechanism literature overlaps conceptually with Binance premium data; the registered test is an internally originated narrow state-transition proposition.
candidates.exact_proposition: A larger absolute Binance USD-M premium index at hour t is positively associated with subsequent 8-hour compression in absolute premium, without interpreting the result as a directional or profitable funding trade.
candidates.feature: ABS_PREMIUM_t = abs(PremiumIndexClose_t), where PremiumIndexClose is the close of the 1-hour USD-M premium-index kline.
candidates.timestamp_convention: t is the 1-hour premium-index kline close boundary; only the completed kline ending at t is used.
candidates.safe_known_after: SAFE-KNOWN-AFTER >= t, after the completed premium-index kline is available.
candidates.outcome: COMPRESSION_8H_t = abs(PremiumIndexClose_t) - abs(PremiumIndexClose_{t+8h}); positive values mean compression.
candidates.inclusion_exclusion: BTCUSDT USD-M perpetual premium-index series only; no funding-rate proxy, open interest, spot substitution, or cross-asset pooling.
candidates.missing_data: Any missing hourly premium-index kline, nonfinite value, duplicate timestamp, or continuity failure blocks the candidate and common campaign; no row dropping.
candidates.duplicate_behavior: Duplicate kline identity or conflicting replacement is an integrity failure; no deduplication rescue.
candidates.benchmark: Zero-compression benchmark; no funding or PnL benchmark.
candidates.primary_metric_statistic: OLS slope beta on ABS_PREMIUM with intercept; two-sided HAC p-value and 95% confidence interval, direction gated.
candidates.inference_procedure: Newey-West Bartlett HAC with fixed lag 8 hourly observations; no lag selection.
candidates.dependence_handling: HAC accounts for overlapping 8-hour outcomes and serial dependence.
candidates.multiplicity_treatment: Holm step-down across exactly JFP01, JFP02, JFP03 raw two-sided p-values at familywise alpha 0.05.
candidates.materiality_rule: Supported only if beta has the preregistered sign, Holm p <= 0.05, and the predicted compression difference between the 90th and 10th feature percentiles is >= 1 basis point of premium ratio.
candidates.historical_source_contract: Binance first-party USD-M premium-index kline endpoint/archive semantics: /fapi/v1/premiumIndexKlines with interval 1h and the corresponding data.binance.vision futures/um premiumIndexKlines/BTCUSDT/1h archive when available; archive .CHECKSUM, response schema, timestamp unit, and post-materialization SHA-256 are mandatory. If the official archive/API cannot provide reproducible historical coverage, classify BLOCKED_BEFORE_EXECUTION rather than substitute funding or open interest.
candidates.prospective_observation_semantics: Persist ABS_PREMIUM and its event receipt after the completed hourly kline is known, before t+8h outcome maturity; no order, position, or capital action.
candidates.prospective_maturity_condition: Outcome is mature at t+8h and evaluated once against the immutable event identity.
candidates.no_rescue_rule: No funding-rate replacement, sign reversal, alternate horizon, log transform, open-interest input, asset, subgroup, or PnL target may replace this candidate after freeze.
candidates.candidate_origin_provenance: Mechanism prior only; no local QntyLab outcome was used to choose this specification.

candidates.display_name: Aggressive flow / abnormal volume pressure -> subsequent realized volatility
candidates.citation: Andersen, Bollerslev, Diebold and Labys (2003), Modeling and Forecasting Realized Volatility, Econometrica; Corsi (2009), A Simple Approximate Long-Memory Model of Realized Volatility, Journal of Financial Econometrics.
candidates.external_sample: Foundational realized-volatility and HAR-RV methodology; not a claim that this exact flow feature was established by those papers.
candidates.external_universe: Foundational financial return samples; no external asset universe imported.
candidates.overlap_risk: The volatility target and HAR-style benchmark are literature-informed; the frozen Binance taker-flow feature is a new narrow mechanism test and must not be confused with the prior JH01 persistence proposition.
candidates.exact_proposition: After controlling for a frozen HAR-style realized-volatility baseline, larger abnormal aggressive-flow pressure at hour t is positively associated with subsequent 24-hour realized volatility.
candidates.feature: FLOW_PRESSURE_t = abs((taker_buy_quote_volume_t - (quote_volume_t - taker_buy_quote_volume_t)) / quote_volume_t) * log(1 + quote_volume_t / median(quote_volume_{t-24:t-1})), using completed 1-hour klines.
candidates.timestamp_convention: t is the completed 1-hour kline close boundary; the 24-hour volume median uses the preceding 24 completed hourly klines only.
candidates.safe_known_after: SAFE-KNOWN-AFTER >= t, after the completed 1-hour kline and preceding-volume lookback are available.
candidates.outcome: RV24_future_t = sqrt(sum_{j=1}^{24} log(C_{t+j}/C_{t+j-1})^2), using subsequent hourly USD-M kline closes.
candidates.inclusion_exclusion: BTCUSDT USD-M perpetual hourly klines only; no VPIN, toxicity score, ML feature, order book, liquidation, open interest, or cross-asset pooling.
candidates.missing_data: Any missing hourly kline, nonfinite price/volume, zero-volume denominator, duplicate timestamp, or continuity failure blocks the candidate and common campaign; no row dropping.
candidates.duplicate_behavior: Duplicate kline identity or conflicting replacement is an integrity failure; no deduplication rescue.
candidates.benchmark: Frozen HAR-style baseline with prior 1-hour, 24-hour, 168-hour, and 720-hour realized-volatility aggregates; no tuned alternative benchmark.
candidates.primary_metric_statistic: Incremental OLS coefficient gamma on FLOW_PRESSURE in RV24_future = alpha + frozen HAR baseline terms + gamma*FLOW_PRESSURE; two-sided HAC p-value and 95% confidence interval, direction gated.
candidates.inference_procedure: Newey-West Bartlett HAC with fixed lag 24 hourly observations; no lag selection.
candidates.dependence_handling: HAC accounts for overlapping 24-hour outcomes and serial dependence; the baseline is fixed before any local outcomes are opened.
candidates.multiplicity_treatment: Holm step-down across exactly JFP01, JFP02, JFP03 raw two-sided p-values at familywise alpha 0.05.
candidates.materiality_rule: Supported only if gamma has the preregistered sign, Holm p <= 0.05, and the incremental out-of-sample descriptive RV24 reduction in a fixed expanding-origin one-step forecast comparison is at least 1% relative to the baseline; this forecast diagnostic is not a second selection gate and cannot rescue a failed primary test.
candidates.historical_source_contract: Binance first-party USD-M monthly archive: data.binance.vision/data/futures/um/monthly/klines/BTCUSDT/1h/BTCUSDT-1h-YYYY-MM.zip; fields must include quote volume and taker-buy quote volume, expected timestamps milliseconds, .CHECKSUM and post-materialization SHA-256 mandatory.
candidates.prospective_observation_semantics: Persist FLOW_PRESSURE, frozen HAR inputs, and event receipt after t is safe, before the 24-hour outcome matures; no order, position, or capital action.
candidates.prospective_maturity_condition: Outcome is mature at t+24h and evaluated once against the immutable event identity.
candidates.no_rescue_rule: No VPIN, toxicity score, signed/unsigned switch, alternate horizon, ML feature, order-book input, open-interest input, parameter tuning, or return target may replace this candidate after freeze.
candidates.candidate_origin_provenance: Literature/mechanism prior only; no local QntyLab outcome was used to choose this specification.
